column1: # Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour (Switch 2, update v262144). In bring-up
# NintendoWare's Bezel Engine, SDK 20.5.29 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2; modules main + subsdk0, subsdk1 (movie), subsdk3 + sdk (subsdk2 and subsdk4, C / libc, are not loaded:
# main takes nothing from them the host does not supply). Started from dm/games/profile_guess.py's profile; the memory below was changed by hand (see the note).
# The Switch 2's 9 GB, as Splatoon Raiders and Star Fox have it: 256 MB in front + alias region + 256 MB stack region + heap region. The guess (a 5 GB block with a 4.4 GB alias region
# and a 1 GB pool) ran out at boot: the Bezel Engine's allocator found no room and stopped on its NotNull check
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on
